title: A Passage for the Monsoon
author: Casper Thornbury
blurb: Coral Dravenmoor, a desert ranger tracking a thief across nothing, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. Then the tide reveals a cave that legends charge admission to — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must outlast the monsoon with a leaking boat and a stranger's help, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
